sentences.text: KSR,J & GTK,J I.A.No.01 of 2026 Heard both sides.
For the reasons stated in the affidavit filed in support of this application, delay of 759 days in filing the present Criminal Appeal is hereby condoned.

The petitioner/appellant was convicted under Section 376(2)(i) of IPC and Section 6 r/w Section 5(m) of POCSO Act and he was sentenced to suffer rigorous imprisonment for a period of twenty (20) years and also to pay a fine of Rs.1,000/- (Rupees One Thousand only, in default simple imprisonment for a period of one (01) month for the offence under Section 6 r/w 5(m) of POCSO Act, 2012.
The appellant is aged about sixty (60) years and the allegations made against him that he committed rape on a minor girl aged about 11 years, who is mentally retarded person.
Prima facie, the medical evidence adduced through PW.7-doctor, corroborates the prosecution evidence.
Further, the victim was also examined as PW.6.
In view of the evidence of PWs.6 and 7, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner at this stage.
